content: Looking forward to see you all in Leuven in 2027. :tada:
We look forward to seeing you all there!
It's not completely unreasonable to do this by bike.

Here's the announcement @Dieuwertje Bloemen posted to the mailing list: https://groups.google.com/g/dataverse-community/c/TLl0FIcZqRI/m/1A9JdMkzAgAJ

Exciting! :tada: :flag_belgium:
I went ahead and added it to the community calendar.

I just updated the banner at dataverse.org to match what we have at gdcc.io (thanks @Dieuwertje Bloemen for updating that!):

I also updated https://dataverse.org/events to mention the 2027 meeting.

In all cases, I'm linking back to this topic in Zulip but when there is a web page ready for the 2027 DCM, please ping me and we can update all of the above!

Hi Community,

If you manage an installation, you should have received this email today. We do have bouncebacks from some emails on record and are missing email contacts for others. Please ensure you provide feedback (once!) in the survey.

Dear Community:
This survey is for installation managers and teams and should NOT be distributed to repository users nor posted on social media.

As we move forward in planning the 2027DCM, May 25 to May 28, 2027, at KU Leuven in Leuven, Belgium https://dcm2027.org/

It's time to collect information from our Dataverse Community Installations on the topics of interest for the event. Please ensure each organization responds only once.

Dataverse2027 Survey on Topics
The deadline to respond is November 6, 2026.

We look forward to hearing from you and seeing you in Belgium in 2027!
Please don't hesitate to contact us if you have any questions. More
information about the conference will follow in the coming weeks.

Regards,

Sonia
